title: A2A Communication Core Module
summary: This module manages Agent-to-Agent (A2A) communication, including configuration, update mechanisms (polling, streaming, push notifications), and task delegation wrappers. It enables agents to interact with remote A2A agents and handle various communication protocols.

nodes.label: Configure A2A Protocol
nodes.title: A2A Protocol Configuration
nodes.description: Defines the overall configuration for Agent-to-Agent communication, including endpoint, authentication, timeouts, and update mechanisms.

nodes.label: Configure A2A Client
nodes.title: A2A Client Configuration
nodes.description: Specifies client-side settings for connecting to remote A2A agents, covering communication parameters, accepted output modes, and extensions.

nodes.label: Get Default Update Config
nodes.title: Provide Default Update Config
nodes.description: Provides a default configuration for the update mechanism, typically defaulting to streaming updates.

nodes.label: Define Polling Parameters
nodes.title: Polling Handler Parameters
nodes.description: Specifies parameters for polling-based update handlers, such as intervals, timeouts, and history length.

nodes.label: Define Streaming Parameters
nodes.title: Streaming Handler Parameters
nodes.description: Defines parameters specific to streaming-based update handlers, currently an empty set but extensible.

nodes.label: Define Push Notification Parameters
nodes.title: Push Notification Handler Parameters
nodes.description: Outlines parameters for push notification handlers, including configuration, result storage, and polling intervals.

nodes.label: Manage Polling Updates
nodes.title: Polling-based Update Handler
nodes.description: Implements the logic for handling A2A task updates through periodic polling of the remote agent's status.

nodes.label: Manage Streaming Updates
nodes.title: Streaming-based Update Handler
nodes.description: Manages A2A task updates using Server-Sent Events (SSE) streaming, including interruption recovery and event processing.

nodes.label: Manage Push Notification Updates
nodes.title: Push Notification Update Handler
nodes.description: Handles A2A task updates via webhooks/push notifications, waiting for external callbacks to deliver results.

nodes.label: Execute Task Asynchronously via A2A
nodes.title: Async A2A Task Execution Wrapper
nodes.description: Asynchronously executes a task by delegating it to a remote A2A agent, applying A2A configurations and extensions.

nodes.label: Execute Task Synchronously via A2A
nodes.title: Sync A2A Task Execution Wrapper
nodes.description: Synchronously executes a task by delegating it to a remote A2A agent, applying A2A configurations and extensions.

nodes.label: Initiate Agent Asynchronously via A2A
nodes.title: Async A2A Agent Kickoff Wrapper
nodes.description: Asynchronously initiates an agent's workflow, potentially delegating the kickoff to a remote A2A agent.

nodes.label: Initiate Agent Synchronously via A2A
nodes.title: Sync A2A Agent Kickoff Wrapper
nodes.description: Synchronously initiates an agent's workflow, potentially delegating the kickoff to a remote A2A agent.

nodes.label: Retrieve Agent Card
nodes.title: Fetch Agent Card Utility
nodes.description: Fetches the metadata (AgentCard) of a remote A2A agent using the provided A2A configuration.

nodes.label: CrewAI Agent
nodes.title: CrewAI Agent Instance
nodes.description: An instance of a CrewAI agent that can delegate tasks or kick off workflows.

nodes.label: A2A Communication Client
nodes.title: A2A Client Interface
nodes.description: The underlying client responsible for making HTTP/gRPC requests to remote A2A endpoints.

nodes.label: A2A Communication Message
nodes.title: A2A Message Format
nodes.description: The structured data format used for communication between agents in the A2A protocol.

nodes.label: Remote Agent Metadata
nodes.title: AgentCard Data Structure
nodes.description: A data structure containing information about a remote A2A agent, including its capabilities and endpoint.

nodes.label: CrewAI Task
nodes.title: Task Definition
nodes.description: A unit of work or instruction given to an agent for execution.

nodes.label: Task Execution Result
nodes.title: A2A Task Result
nodes.description: The outcome of an A2A task execution, including status, result, and history.

nodes.label: Base Update Configuration
nodes.title: Update Config Interface
nodes.description: Abstract base configuration for different A2A update mechanisms (polling, streaming, push notifications).

nodes.label: Push Notification Configuration
nodes.title: Push Notification Settings
nodes.description: Specific configuration details for setting up and receiving push notifications from A2A agents.

nodes.label: Push Notification Result Store
nodes.title: Result Storage for Push Notifications
nodes.description: A mechanism for temporarily storing results received via push notifications until they are processed.

nodes.label: CrewAI Event Bus
nodes.title: CrewAI Event System
nodes.description: A central system for emitting and listening to various events within the CrewAI framework, including A2A specific events.

nodes.label: A2A Extension Registry
nodes.title: A2A Extension Manager
nodes.description: A repository or manager for client-side A2A extensions that augment agent behavior.

groups.label: A2A Configuration
groups.title: A2A Configuration
groups.description: Manages the setup and parameters for Agent-to-Agent communication, defining how agents connect and interact.

groups.label: Update Mechanism Parameters
groups.title: Update Mechanism Parameters
groups.description: Defines the specific arguments and settings for different A2A update handling strategies.

groups.label: A2A Update Handlers
groups.title: A2A Update Handlers
groups.description: Implements the core logic for receiving and processing updates from remote A2A agents using various communication patterns.

groups.label: A2A Delegation Wrappers
groups.title: A2A Delegation Wrappers
groups.description: Provides methods for delegating tasks and initiating agent workflows to remote A2A agents, integrating A2A capabilities into existing agent functions.

groups.label: A2A Utilities
groups.title: A2A Utilities
groups.description: Contains helper functions for common A2A operations, such as retrieving agent metadata.
